_about: Public-domain John Wyclif (d. 1384), Oxford theologian and forerunner of the Reformation, in his English works for the Word Hoard: Select English Works, edited by Thomas Arnold (3 vols., Oxford, 1869-1871); The English Works of Wyclif hitherto unprinted, edited by F. D. Matthew for the Early English Text Society (1880); and Tracts and Treatises, with selections and translations from his manuscripts and Latin works, edited by Robert Vaughan for the Wycliffe Society (1845). Middle English texts with nineteenth-century editorial matter. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 81 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wyclif-select-english-1: Select English works of John Wyclif, vol. 1 (Oxford : Clarendon Press, 1869)
wyclif-select-english-2: Select English works of John Wyclif, vol. 2 (Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1869)
wyclif-select-english-3: Select English works of John Wyclif, vol. 3 (Oxford : Clarendon Press, 1869)
wyclif-english-works-eets: The English works of Wyclif : Hitherto Unprinted (London : Published for the Early English text society, by Kegan Paul, Trübner & Co., Ltd., 1880)
wyclif-tracts-treatises: Tracts and treatises of John de Wycliffe : with selections and translations from his manuscripts, and Latin works (London : Printed for the Society by Blackburn and Pardon, 1845)

_excluded.wyclif-doubtful: An Apology for Lollard Doctrines (1842) and The Last Age of the Church (1840), both only attributed to him and now generally denied to him
_excluded.wyclif-bible: the Wycliffite Bible (Forshall and Madden, 1850) and the 1879 New Testament, which belong with the English Bibles
_excluded.wyclif-lives: lives of him by Vaughan, Le Bas, Lechler and others

_pending.wyclif-latin-works: the Wyclif Society Latin Works (about 35 volumes, 1883-1922) and the Trialogus (1869): a large set whose volumes still have to be matched to titles; a separate decision
